ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Program: A Case Study in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future program and the $90M Medicaid fraud scheme involving the program
questions: What was the extent of the fraud?
How did the program fail to prevent the fraud?
ideas.insight: The Feeding Our Future program was a prime example of a program that was vulnerable to fraud, and the investigation into the program could reveal larger issues with Medicaid oversight
